publication.head: codex/5615-csdlc-ci-fastwork-routing
publication.title: [v0.91.8][CI] Require truthful C-SDLC v2 and Runtime validation routing
publication.body:
Closes #5615

Repairs CI classification so C-SDLC v2 Rust changes run their standalone test, format, and strict-Clippy proof, lifecycle metadata alone remains lightweight, and mixed Runtime v3 plus C-SDLC v2 changes require both focused lanes. Stable aggregation now fails closed when a selected standalone lane is skipped or malformed. Cargo validation state is routed to a validated external build root with child-symlink escape rejection.

Focused classifier, Runtime, selector, workflow, and external-root contracts pass. The complete standalone C-SDLC v2 test/fmt/strict-Clippy suite passes on /Volumes/FastWork. Mandatory exact review found three P1 gaps; all were fixed, revalidated, and exact re-review passed with zero findings.
